name: Becky
headline:
Book Becky
directly.
sub: Same hands, same chair, every time. Text me and I'll hold a slot — no calling the shop, no waiting on hold.
priceNote: Ask me about pricing — it depends what you want done.
facts: Text — fastest way to reach me
A photo if you have a look in mind
scanNote: Opens a text already written. Send the day and time you want and I'll confirm.
smsBody: Hi Becky - I'd like to book a nail appointment. I'm free:
story: Becky does nails at Victoria's. She's built her whole book one client at a time, by remembering exactly what you asked for last time.

name: Rich
headline:
Car wash
without
leaving.
sub: I wash cars right here on the weekends. Park, hand me the keys or don't — you never have to move it.
priceNote: Full outside wash & tires. Same price every car, no add-ons.
scanNote: Opens a text already written. Send your spot number and a time, and I'll confirm.
smsBody: Hi Rich - I'd like a car wash. My spot and time:
story: Rich has lived in this building for years. He's retired now — spent his working life in the courts — and he does this because he likes doing it well, not because he has to.

name: Dolores
headline:
Say thank
you to
Dolores.
sub: She's helped just about everyone in this building at some point, and never once asked for anything. If she's helped you, here's a way to say so.
priceNote: Or none at all — she'd tell you not to.
facts: Say it to her face — that counts more
scanNote: Opens her tip link. Nothing is shared with anyone else in the building.
story: Dolores is past ninety and has quietly helped half this building — groceries, a spare key, sitting with someone who needed company. She has never once asked for anything back.
